description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI infrastructure startup as its first engineering hire. You will work directly with the founder to evolve a working AI-powered service business product into reliable infrastructure that can scale to a large user base.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build scalable architecture, data models, and infrastructure for the product.

 - Develop the agent runtime, including orchestration, memory, verification, and multi-agent workflows.

 - Work across backend, infrastructure, frontend, and AI agents to deliver what the product needs.

 - Set technical direction and establish engineering practices as the team grows.

 - Ship improvements regularly to businesses using the product in recruiting and web agency services.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of experience shipping production software, or an equivalent record as a founder, solo builder, or exceptional early-career engineer.

 - Experience building and operating LLM or AI agent systems used by real customers.

 - Strong full-stack range, with the ability to take work from backend and infrastructure through to the user interface.

 - Experience scaling a working prototype into production infrastructure, and making technical decisions independently in an early-stage team.

 - A track record of shipping frequently and explaining the difficult technical decisions behind your work.

 - Founder experience or experience building agent orchestration, memory, evaluations, verification, or multi-agent workflows is valuable.

 - Based in Europe and willing to relocate to San Francisco within the first year.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Annual compensation is €80,000 to €140,000. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for the move to San Francisco.


LOCATION

Remote within Europe initially, with relocation to San Francisco expected within the first year.
